newsitem.title: UK: UK refers Firstbus buy of SB Holdings to MMC.
newsitem.headline: UK refers Firstbus buy of SB Holdings to MMC.

text.p: The UK Department of Trade and Industry said it referred the planned acquisition by Firstbus Plc of SB Holdings to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission.
Local bus and coach operator Firstbus said in May it had agreed to buy Glasgow-based bus firm SB Holdings for some 96 million stg.
"The Minister considers that the acquisition raises competition concerns in the operation of the bus market in central Scotland...," the DTI said.
The MMC will have to produce a report on the matter by December 23.
Shares in Firstbus fell 5-1/2 pence to 163 pence by 1418 GMT. They had traded at 169 pence prior to the referral announcement.
